notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
A minor performance update and hopefully a small fix to a rare, but big issue 🔥

‼️Additions‼️
🏋️Performance Upgrade
We have done a little tweaking in hopes of improving the performance specifically in the village.
For those interested, according to some analytics, it seems that the main eater of frames in the village are the shadows.
With that in mind, we tweaked values and changed settings, and noticed some improvements on our PCs.
Since our PCs are pretty high end, we are hopeful, that these changes will improve the FPS for anyone who had bigger issues in the past.

‼️Bug Fixes‼️
📜  Save File Breaking
We had an issue, hiding deep inside a single quest, related to a specific kitchen upgrade, that had a missing quest link.
We believe this may have been the cause for some people to get a damaged save file.
The issue has been very difficult to reproduce, but we are hopeful that this will have taken care of it.
That being said, this does not restore save files that have been damage.
We hope that anyone experiencing any problems with their save file will communicate this with us. 
It is very important to us, that Delicious Dungeon is a playable experience without any issues that ruins a play through.
Should we hear about more issues related to broken save files, we are considering to create a tool that can fix them.

Happy Holidays to everyone that celebrates!
Have a wonderful time! ⛄

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.01
Some fixes to bugs and issues you guys have found. Thanks for playing and bringing these things to our attention! ❤️
 
‼️Bug Fixes‼️

📜  Order Deletion
Due to a missing check, it was possible to delete orders that you didn't give up to yourself.
That is now fixed and you should only be able to delete your own orders.

🍽️  All Dishes Unlockable
There was an issue with the second to last dish in the game the dish after the Layer Cake (Lasagna).
That is now fixed and you should be able to unlock all 25 dishes in the game.

💬  Cook Book Guide Dialogue
Almost not a bug, but we fixed the dialogue for the Cook Book Guide.
Before, when you talk to him the first time, he shows you with [Unlock Recipe] that you have new recipes to unlock.
That went away, once you entered any conversation path. We fixed that and he now always shows the new recipes you can unlock.

🇬🇧  🇩🇪  Translations
Lots of translation fixes. Hopefully we got them all this time 😛
Keep posting if you find any other missing ones.

🌺  Botanist Selection
The Botanist did not have all the non meat items in the game before.
That is now fixed and he will always offer anything you are eligible to loot.

🍰  Milk and Sugar
The drop rate of milk and sugar was wrong.
The Demor and Maldemos enemies (the big versions of the Beses and Bosos), were supposed to always drop milk and sugar.
Now they do so abundantly.

notes.title: Beta Playtest Update
notes.content:
It's been a while, but thanks to our hard-working testers we've found a lot of bugs that we've (hopefully) fixed.

To test this theory, we have uploaded the new version of our beta build and are ready for more feedback!

tl;dr
We have tried to fix most of the hard stuck/game breaking bugs, so saving should now work pretty well, but we know there is still a bug with the kitchen helper and the combat tutorial.

And now the long list of changes for those who want to read through all of them:

Change Log
Version 0.02

A note before we get into it.
First of all, sorry it took us so long to post.
We wanted to be active and instead we got hung up on lots of little things instead of just updating. We want to try to update more regularly.
One of the reasons it took so long is because with fixing some issues others ended up becoming more visible. But that should not stop us from giving you guys an updated version of the game, so here we go.
Lastly, we added a little “known issues” list you can find at the end of the change log.
Thanks, with all our heart, your support helps us a lot!
We appreciate you, with all the love in the world.

Digital Cauldron

‼️New Beta Feature‼️
📜  Export Logs
Added a new feature to export the games logs. This can be very helpful for us, whenever you have an error or a bug. Just press the keyboard combo Alt + E + L (easy to remember as export logs) and the game will create a folder named Logs in your game directory where a text file with a time stamp as its name will be created. You can send these logs to us when you tell us of the issue you found. 

‼️Bug Fixes‼️
Save Files
Major Fix, save files should no longer be corruptible and a save file should always be loadable, no matter what.

UI Input
Fixing some double input that happened at times.

Improved and fixed Drop rate
The Quality of the items dropped had a bug and did not feel quite right beyond that. We rescaled it a little bit so the games beginning would not feel as bad.

Mouse input in UI
We removed any detection of your mouse position in all the UIs. You can still use the mouse as a confirmation button, but what button you hover over will no longer be affecting your selection.
Developer Note: We are still committed to improving the general mouse and keyboard input overall. This is just one of the first steps we have been taking.

‼️ Reworks and additions ‼️
Text and Translation
Major fixing and filling of missing text and translations.

New Lock-On
New and improved Lock on Icon.

UI Polish
Improved and reworked a lot of UI Elements.

Beetle Buff History
You can now see the buffs you already selected for your beetle companion.

Village Life
We added a lot more details to the village to make it feel even cozier and alive.

Tutorials
We added a few more tutorials to some functionality that wasn’t entirely clear.

Beetle rescaling
Rescaled the damage of the beetle companion. It was a bit too strong early on and lost strength when you kept progressing. Now it is the other way around, the beetle starts out a little weaker, but becomes a very solid source of damage, if you upgrade him and get find a good buff combination.

More Dialogue
We added a lot more dialogue options for most of the NPCs.

More Audio FX
We added a lot more audio feedback all over the place (more is still to come).

Keyboard and Mouse Heat-Meter
Added keyboard and mouse controls for the Heat-Meter in the kitchen.


‼️Known Issues‼️
Kitchen Chef Stuck
The Kitchen Chef can get you stuck when you talk to her. We have not been able to reproduce this issue consistently, so any input on the issue will be feedback (the absence of the problem on your end can also be insightful)

Fighting Tutorial Quest
The Fighting tutorial can make issues, if it is not completed and you talk to the Dungeon Guild Master later. 


PS: There are of course still lots of small issues present and also a lot of things we fixed but did not mention directly.
Don't let any of that stop you from posting issues you've found though. Its better to have an issue posted several times then us not knowing about it.

notes.title: Post Gamescom News
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We had an amazing time at Gamescom 2022!

Thank you so much to everyone who played the Delicious Dungeon Demo, either in person at Gamescom or at home via Steam. We received a lot of wonderful feedback, which will help us during further development. We are very hyped to continue working on the game!

During Gamescom we updated the Demo on site with a few bug fixes, which we are now able to push to Steam. 

The Fixes:
- Most importantly, Keyboard support is fixed. It now shows the Keyboard prompts and Control Layout
- Items don't disappear when switching them between the kitchen inventories 
- Prevents player from getting stuck in the kitchen
- Stops player from falling into infinity
- Gives player more healing items
- A little on screen lock-on reminder

Since this is still a Pre-Alpha, the game might have more bugs in there, so don't be too confused when something does not work. We're working on making everything run smoothly.
You can always join our discord server ( https://discord.gg/SDRQvEw2By ) to let us know which bugs disrupt your gameplay!

We thank you all so much for your support and hope that you will follow us on this game development journey!
